editorial.blurb: Family-owned Taqueria Tayahua serves authentic Mexican food with pride, from hand-made tortillas to fresh salsas that get the flavors exactly right.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the steak tacos and ask for extra salsa on the side — reviewers rave about the fresh, well-balanced salsas and the perfect cilantro-onion-steak ratio, and definitely try their house-made horchata.
